svg.aria-label: Lines of pull of the muscles that move the jaw — 下颌运动肌的拉力方向

text.aria-label: Lines of pull of the muscles that move the jaw — 下颌运动肌的拉力方向
text.tspan: Lines of pull of the muscles that move the jaw
下颌运动肌的拉力方向

text.aria-label: Temporalis, posterior fibres: pull back (retrusion) — 颞肌后部纤维：向后拉（后缩）
text.tspan: Temporalis, posterior fibres: pull back (retrusion)
颞肌后部纤维：向后拉（后缩）

text.aria-label: Lateral pterygoid: pulls the neck forward — 翼外肌：把下颌颈向前拉
text.tspan: Lateral pterygoid: pulls the neck forward
翼外肌：把下颌颈向前拉

text.aria-label: Masseter: pulls up, on the outside of the ramus — 咬肌：在下颌支外侧向上拉
text.tspan: Masseter: pulls up, on the outside of the ramus
咬肌：在下颌支外侧向上拉

text.aria-label: Medial pterygoid (deep, dashed): pulls up — 翼内肌（深面，虚线）：向上拉
text.tspan: Medial pterygoid (deep, dashed): pulls up
翼内肌（深面，虚线）：向上拉

text.aria-label: Infrahyoid muscles hold the hyoid bone down — 舌骨下肌把舌骨固定在下方
text.tspan: Infrahyoid muscles hold the hyoid bone down
舌骨下肌把舌骨固定在下方

text.aria-label: Temporalis, anterior fibres: pull straight up — 颞肌前部纤维：垂直向上提
text.tspan: Temporalis, anterior fibres: pull straight up
颞肌前部纤维：垂直向上提
Coronoid process
冠突

text.aria-label: Suprahyoid muscles: pull the chin down and back — 舌骨上肌：把颏部向后下方拉
text.tspan: Suprahyoid muscles: pull the chin down and back
舌骨上肌：把颏部向后下方拉
Hyoid bone
舌骨

text.aria-label: Which muscles for which movement — 哪个动作用哪些肌
text.tspan: Which muscles for which movement
哪个动作用哪些肌

svg.text: Close: masseter, temporalis, medial pterygoid. Open:
gravity, then lateral pterygoid and the suprahyoid
muscles. Protrude: both lateral pterygoids. Retrude:
posterior temporalis. Side to side: the pterygoids of the
闭口：咬肌、颞肌、翼内肌。张口：先靠重力，再靠翼外肌和舌骨上
肌。前伸：两侧翼外肌。后缩：颞肌后部。侧方：对侧的两块翼肌。

text.aria-label: Arrows start at the attachment on the mandible and point along the pull of the muscle. — 箭头从肌在下颌骨上的附着处出发，指向肌的拉力方向。
text.tspan: Arrows start at the attachment on the mandible and point along the pull of the muscle.
箭头从肌在下颌骨上的附着处出发，指向肌的拉力方向。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
